beats.say: First Ballon d'Or: Harry Kane wins at chaotic London ceremony.
The ceremony at the London Palladium was called the most chaotic ever by the BBC.
Kane claimed the prize for the first time in his career.
Yet the night was remembered for chaos more than the winner.
The BBC said it was the most chaotic ceremony ever.
A historic win overshadowed by a ceremony unravelling live on stage.
